body_markdown:
HAUPPAUGE, N.Y., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — AmpliTech Group, Inc. (AMPG, AMPGR, AMPGZ) is correcting a typographical error in the earnings release date in the opening paragraph of its November 9 announcement, which incorrectly stated August 12.


AmpliTech will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after market close on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The Company will host its conference call that day at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss the results.


**Investor Earnings Call Details**


Date/Time: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 5:00 PM ET


Dial-in Number: 1-833-630-0019 (domestic) or 1-412-317-1807 (international)


Online Replay: Audio file and call transcript will be posted to AmpliTech’s[news page](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=xQ2PMvNY4o7lgTyYEIQIUaAtj1luPyLt1UjpvrisDeTcxmjxOJWzsnAUKDMsKESJcVdHZ1B3Oj7tnnRIjphW9V9nCBwtX-gXssQA_Pb0nik=) when available.


Investor questions may be submitted toinvestors@amplitechgroup.com prior to the call


**About AmpliTech Group, Inc.**


AmpliTech Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMPG, AMPGW) designs, develops, and manufactures advanced RF and microwave signal-processing components and systems for satellite, 5G/6G telecom, quantum computing, defense, and space applications. Its five divisions, AmpliTech Inc., Specialty Microwave, Spectrum Semiconductor Materials, AmpliTech Group Microwave Design Center, and AmpliTech Group 5G Divisions work symbiotically and serve customers worldwide. Through continuous innovation and U.S.-based manufacturing, AmpliTech is enabling the next generation of connectivity and communication systems. For further information, please visit[www.amplitechgroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HS9ligBCEdU_HD4Esun-5z0NPz6qAKpYXcFuEsdvdxqj652F2Cd6zCiyW1OEJTy5O1bjKJsKQNwVRuDZJ8rCtV_uALNevq-Vs17HNRCqBTEElmZrX75u7gXp4jHInYzsZrF1E6SdPgp2s0njWVgQ1Fkd4jnHDLgJCRI20e1-w4lr5K_Gc3Vc8MfD-dLBVuO4B4sb-gAiDPirdyixIRoUVMdIub0oOCKNnbWk-tatUvbKpTDiHj31mcqdI5goN-auXYG3bXP4TVkvzMRpVmyd_g==)
